text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text: ...I have a trainer.

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text:
He's so kind, like the big brother in<n>my book. He
took my hand even<n>though I'm so useless...

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text:
She's so kind, like the big sister in<n>my book. She
took my hand even<n>though I'm so useless...

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text: That's why I decided I want to<n>become a blue rose.

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text:
I want to be a wonderful person who<n>brings
happiness wherever they go,<n>not a useless girl who
just brings<n>misfor—

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text: Ah, it's almost time for training...

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text: ...A little jogging beforehand can't<n>hurt.

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text:
Hehe... Rice Shower enters the<n>starting gate, the
crowd cheering her<n>name—

text_block_list.name: Umamusume A
text_block_list.text: Hyaaa!

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text: Hyaaa?!

text_block_list.name: Mihono Bourbon
text_block_list.text: Pant... pant...

text_block_list.name: Umamusume A
text_block_list.text:
And that's another new record,<n>Bourbon! Looks
like the star of the<n>Classics this year is already
decided!

text_block_list.name: Umamusume B
text_block_list.text:
Wow... that was really incredible. Hey,<n>Bourbon!
Would you mind talking—

text_block_list.name: Mihono Bourbon
text_block_list.text: My regimen is not yet complete.<n>Excuse me.

text_block_list.name: Students
text_block_list.text: Hyaaaaa! She's so cool!

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text:
...Incredible. I can't believe so many<n>people came to
the track to see her.

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text: If I run now, I'll probably just get in<n>the way.

text_block_list.name: Monólogo
text_block_list.text:
Rice Shower and I begin working<n>towards the
Twinkle Series today!

text_block_list.name: Monólogo
text_block_list.text:
I head to our rendezvous location, my<n>heart
swelling with anticipation.

text_block_list.name: Monólogo
text_block_list.text: ...But she isn't here.

text_block_list.name: Monólogo
text_block_list.text:
There's still five minutes until our<n>meetup time. As
long as she makes it<n>to practice by then, it'll be
fine.

text_block_list.name: Monólogo
text_block_list.text: ...But she never arrives.

text_block_list.name: Monólogo
text_block_list.text:
I furrow my brow. The fact that she<n>hasn't
contacted me yet means<n>something is definitely
wrong. Where<n>in the world could she be?

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text: Wh-what should I do? Training timemust be over by now... Sigh...

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text: Huh?! What are you doing he—oh...

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text: I-I'm sorry I wasn't able to get to<n>practice on time!

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text:
I-I went for a run... but there were<n>roadworks on the
path I usually take.

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text:
So I tried a different route, but I got<n>lost... and then I
got held up by every<n>single traffic light...

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text: Sniffle... And now it's already thislate...
choice_data_list: It's fine. I'm just glad you're okay.

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text: I-it's not fine!

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text:
Because of me, all the time you put<n>into preparing
today's training was<n>for nothing...

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text: So... if it's all right with you...

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text:
P-please tell me everything that we<n>were going to
do today...

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text:
I don't want to be useless like this<n>forever... I'll
train on my own!

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text: I-is that a no? Right, I bet that's even<n>more trouble...

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text: Huh?!
choice_data_list: You don't have to practice alone. Let's do it together!

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text: Really?! O-okay!

text_block_list.name: Monólogo
text_block_list.text:
...And so, Rice Shower and I begin our<n>journey to
take on the Twinkle<n>Series.
